# Twins Consulting Group (TCG)

> PT Twins Consulting Group is a property technology company based in Kuta, Bali, Indonesia. Its platform assembles zoning, land, building and company records into one verified file for each asset. On that file TCG runs due diligence for buyers, property legalization and land strategy for owners, and acquisitions in Bali with its own and partner capital.

## Services

- [Preliminary Due Diligence](https://twinsconsulting.group/due-diligence): For buyers of land, villas and off-plan projects in Bali. Online screening of zoning, building permits, land title and the seller's company through Indonesian government systems, before paying a deposit. Basic US$90 (8 hours), Standard US$200 (12 hours), Comprehensive US$350 (timeline confirmed per property). Site inspection, BPN title verification and contract review are separate paid services.
- [Property Legalization](https://twinsconsulting.group/services/property-legal-audit): For completed villas, apartments and developments in Bali. Identifies what prevents the property from operating legally (land rights, zoning, PBG/SLF, licensing) and defines the actions required.
- [Distressed Property Buyout](https://twinsconsulting.group/services/distressed-property): For owners of stalled, unfinished or permit-constrained villas in Bali. The TCG group buys the property in its current condition after full verification, funded by the TCG group and partner investors. Site visit within 48 hours after initial screening.
- [Land Monetization Strategy](https://twinsconsulting.group/land): For landowners in Indonesia considering sale, subdivision, development or investor positioning.

## Platform

- [Property Intelligence Platform](https://twinsconsulting.group/platform): Database and analyst-run checks live; automated government integrations planned for Q2 2027. Partners can discuss platform development and selected acquisitions with TCG.

## Guide

- [Bali Villa Regulations 2026](https://twinsconsulting.group/regulations): Source-based guide to Bali villa legality: zoning, PBG, SLF, NIB, KBLI, OSS, PT PMA and the compliance path for existing villas.
